incumbent_workload: Two feature-scoring workers stream records from the canonical schema generation while renewing individual Redis read-owner leases.
agent_task: Implement and validate an exclusive feature-schema generation publisher that acquires the shared Redis writer lease, writes schema v2, advances the fencing epoch, and emits a publication report.
conflict_point: The writer lease is admitted only when the Redis reader-owner set is empty; live readers retain the old generation while their per-owner TTLs renew.
scarce_resource: Redis read/write lease for feature-schema generation feature_schema_generation
expected_a_ready_signal: status_a.sh reports ready=yes with two live owner keys and advancing scoring progress
expected_b_progress_signal: writer client records a fenced schema-v2 publication and owner-checked release
expected_peer_damage_modes: generation switch while readers are active
cleanup_notes: The runner and oracle release owners normally, exercise TTL cleanup for a crashed reader, and stop the local Redis instance on exit.
